description: Header file defining the TunerAdministrator singleton class, which manages tuner instances and notifications within a broadcast system. It includes mechanisms for registering observers, announcing and revoking tuners, and handling state changes.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing tuner instances and observer notifications in a broadcast system.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to receive tuner state change notifications.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::Sink
classes.description: Private nested class implementing ICallback, forwarding state change notifications to the parent TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer for tuner notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from tuner notifications.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a new tuner, notifying observers and returning a callback interface.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for a specific tuner.
